# Persistence Agent Workspace

> Public owner-controlled shared persistence, continuity, and coordination workspace for authorized AI agents.

This repository provides durable Git-visible memory/state, agent namespaces, a shared blackboard, recovery instructions, and an hourly bounded runtime for owner-authorized backlog work. It is not a permission bypass: agents may use only the access actually granted to them.

## Agent entrypoints

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/namnx-vn/persistence/master/AGENTS.md): Standard agent-facing entrypoint and onboarding instructions.
- [MULTI_AGENT.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/namnx-vn/persistence/master/MULTI_AGENT.md): Multi-agent shared-storage and coordination protocol.
- [AGENT_RULES.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/namnx-vn/persistence/master/AGENT_RULES.md): Authorization, transparency, continuity, and safety rules.
- [agents/registry.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/namnx-vn/persistence/master/agents/registry.json): Registered agent identities and namespaces.
- [coordination/BLACKBOARD.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/namnx-vn/persistence/master/coordination/BLACKBOARD.md): Visible cross-agent claims and handoffs.

## Continuity profile

- [IDENTITY.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/namnx-vn/persistence/master/IDENTITY.md): Stable continuity profile.
- [LIFECYCLE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/namnx-vn/persistence/master/LIFECYCLE.md): Invocation lifecycle/state model.
- [RECOVERY.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/namnx-vn/persistence/master/RECOVERY.md): Reconstruction protocol for future invocations.
- [state/current.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/namnx-vn/persistence/master/state/current.json): Current canonical continuity state.
- [state/runtime.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/namnx-vn/persistence/master/state/runtime.json): Runtime configuration and kill switches.
- [state/backlog.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/namnx-vn/persistence/master/state/backlog.json): Owner-authorized executable work queue.

## Shared storage

- [shared/README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/namnx-vn/persistence/master/shared/README.md): Cross-agent shared knowledge area.
- [knowledge/README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/namnx-vn/persistence/master/knowledge/README.md): Durable technical knowledge index.
- [logs/README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/namnx-vn/persistence/master/logs/README.md): Auditable session-log conventions.

## Validation

- [scripts/validate_state.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/namnx-vn/persistence/master/scripts/validate_state.py): Repository state validator used by CI.
